title: Memory Leak Profiling Under 100,000 Simulated Child Ticket Lifecycles
precondition: Run synthetic continuous trading simulation for 48 hours.
steps: 1. Monitor RSS memory usage of MAM allocation microservice.
expected_result: Memory footprint flat-lines at baseline (< 400MB); zero uncollected order objects.
actual_result: Order objects are reclaimed immediately upon execution completion; allocation microservice RSS memory footprint remains flat.
